content_of_post_to_answer: Is it normal for a 15 years old brother to fondle his 13 years old younger sister?
answer: Age alone does not make this normal or harmless. A 15-year-old may be curious or immature, but touching a 13-year-old sibling sexually crosses a boundary that requires attention, safety, and accountability. The important distinction is between ordinary sibling affection and behavior involving sexual contact or pressure. When a younger sibling’s boundaries are violated, it can affect trust and emotional safety for years, so it should not be dismissed as “just a phase.”
